source_provenance: Raw SHA256 identify tested feature bytes; LF-normalized hashes identify Git blobs. New CA campaign ran after preserving teammate PR19. No own app changes relative to that baseline.

scope.hosts: two trusted Docker-admin maintenance containers; independent rootfs, journal and owner volumes on one PC
scope.availability: Explicit resume of the same stopped actor or checkpoint-bound replacement of a missing actor; survivor-volume flock; no automatic election, physical-host or power-loss guarantee.
scope.online_services: no Docker socket or offline root/backup-key mounts; executor socket is root-equivalent trusted maintenance access
scope.actor_recovery: Explicit recover-takeover; all current/predecessor IDs absent; paired checkpoints/current owners/pinned objects; identity transfer under survivor flock. No new epoch per replacement.
scope.limits: Same PC/kernel/parent Docker and surviving journal/images. No quorum/automatic election/power-loss or arbitrary replica-conflict recovery guarantee.
scope.application: No app/detection/policy/evaluation changes; no AWS, paid LLM, real accounts or OS trust changes.
scope.management: Existing two nine-volume management cells and independent CA/PG DinD replication reused. Completed recovery never restores old security snapshots.

earlier_windows_before_pr19.scope: Starting baseline plus actor recovery, before PR19 integration; not added to final totals.

preflight.scope: Before PR19/docs-only module header and check-label edit; full final-source CA campaign supersedes runtime proof. Never added to final totals.

limits: Same physical PC/kernel/parent Docker and surviving journal/images; not physical-host/site HA.
Docker socket is root-equivalent despite nonroot/read-only/cap-drop.
Explicit replacement only with consistent evidence. General replica disagreement or lost candidate during partial identity write requires investigation.
No valid intent means no recovered request; max16 predecessors per operation.
Checksums detect accidental damage, not malicious Docker-admin rollback; no quorum/election or external monotonic anchor.
Faults are process/container/volume cases, not power-failure durability proof.
No arbitrary authority busy reset, uncertain business POST retries, workload SQLite HA, full CA cold restore, production SLA/RTO/RPO or teammate independent review.
Historical campaigns/preflight/earlier Windows results are not added to this run totals.
